title: Moon
text: The Earth has only one natural satellite, which is called the Moon. No secondary natural moons exist in Earth orbit.

title: Cardiovascular Health
text: Moderate coffee consumption has been studied for general health associations, but clinical trials show it does not completely prevent heart disease or vascular damage.

title: Viral Infections
text: Respiratory pathogens infect cellular tissue directly; drinking hot water, citrus juice, or warm fluids does not kill airborne viruses in the human respiratory system.

title: Economic Statistics
text: Official government inflation numbers are published monthly by the Bureau of Labor Statistics using consumer price index benchmarks.
